title: Part 0 — The Questions Behind the Questions

slides.narration: Part Zero: The Questions Behind the Questions. Before we derive a single number, it helps to be clear about what we're attempting, what it would mean for it to work, and where the ideas come from. Part Zero is the why. Everything after it is the how.

Think of a recipe. A good recipe tells you exactly how to combine the ingredients. But it never tells you why salt tastes salty. The Standard Model of particle physics works the same way. It is a magnificent recipe — the most precisely tested theory in history — but it requires about twenty-six ingredients that must be measured in a laboratory and typed in by hand. It never tells you why they have the values they do.

This framework inverts the relationship. Imagine two cooks. The first has a recipe with twenty-six blanks — add salt to taste, bake until done. Give that cook enough attempts and of course they can reproduce any dish. The second cook has a recipe with no blanks at all — every quantity fixed by the geometry of the bowl and a single ratio. If that cook's dish matches the target across a dozen unrelated dishes, something real is going on, because there were no knobs to turn.

Now: the ground. Try to picture before the universe. Your mind reaches for darkness — but darkness needs light. It reaches for empty space — but space is geometry and geometry hasn't been invented yet. Strip everything away. What remains is Omega: the undifferentiated ground. In Omega, zero and one and infinity are indistinguishable — not because they are equal, but because the machinery that would tell them apart does not exist.

lines: Ω does the only thing it can:
Not a choice — it is what Ω is.
slides.narration: If Omega is featureless, how does anything come from it? Omega does the only thing available to it: it examines its own interior. Not because something outside prompts it — there is no outside. Not because time passes — there is no time. Self-examination is simply what Omega is, the way water is wet. The act is not chosen. It is the unique thing compatible with Omega's nature.

The framework wears its lineage openly. An undifferentiated fullness that is also a void. A single self-knowing act that brings forth multiplicity. A promise that the deepest examination returns you to the ground. This is the Advaitic picture, rendered as mathematics. Atman equals Brahman — the self, fully known, is the ground. What this book explores is whether that picture, pushed through as mathematics, leads somewhere specific.

As of this writing, the framework derives fifty predictions with zero free parameters. The electroweak scale matches to 0.66 parts per million. The Hubble constant matches Planck to 0.03 standard deviations. The full cosmic microwave background — twenty-five hundred data points — is reproduced within cosmic variance. Two items remain as structural hypotheses. Everything else is closed.

Whether this amounts to a theory of everything — the book does not make that claim. Everything is a word that should be earned by experiment, not declared by an author. If the untested predictions are confirmed, the framework will have earned the name. If any are wrong, it will not. That is the wager. With the questions in place, we can begin exploring — at the only place the story can begin, which is the place that is not a place.
